recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-33335 unless a future work group decision reopens the related distinct-answer or repeating-group representation rules.
issue_request: FHIR-33335 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution. It asked core R5 to clarify that repeating question items are represented by one QuestionnaireResponse item with multiple answers, repeating group items are represented by repeated QuestionnaireResponse items with the same linkId, and to add a QuestionnaireResponse qrs-2 invariant for repeated answers.
initial_application: The Jira comments record SDC pre-adoption followed by core commit 35809e0395. That commit rewrote Questionnaire.item.repeats in source/questionnaire/structuredefinition-Questionnaire.xml and added qrs-2 to source/questionnaireresponse/structuredefinition-QuestionnaireResponse.xml.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Questionnaire and QuestionnaireResponse as active build resources. The cited Zulip discussion and 2021-09-02 SDC minutes support the Jira resolution. Later related decisions already on the combined branch, FHIR-38853 and FHIR-55973, refined the same area by clarifying QuestionnaireResponse nesting/diagram guidance and requiring distinct repeated question answers.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current Questionnaire.item.repeats definition/comment distinguishes repeated groups from repeated questions, and the current QuestionnaireResponse.item definition contains qrs-2 with the requested FHIRPath expression.
